name: Premise Yard
descriptionSeed: In the Axiom, nothing is admitted until it has been stated. The Premise Yard is where you say what you are and why you have come, and a Syllogist writes it down and checks it against itself. A premise that holds is admitted. One that contradicts itself is courteously asked to try again.
appearance: A rectangular yard of grey stone, perfectly ordered, the gate arch at one end and a gatehouse at the other with a single door. Above the door, carved: STATE YOUR PREMISE.
encounterFlavor: A trader restating her business for the fourth time until it is consistent; a Syllogist apologising for having been wrong about you; an armed man trying to explain that he is a merchant, and the clerk gently pointing out the swords.
